verdict.rationale: telli documents saved agent revisions: in the agent builder you can pick a draft or any saved revision for a test call, which gives versioning and a way to review a version before use. Nothing shows versioning, diffing, review, or rollback for workflows, and restoring an earlier revision is never described. Missing for 10: version history for workflow automations, change review or diffs, documented rollback/restore of a prior revision, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Pick the agent version (your draft with unsaved changes or any saved revision)
